clue.text: Story to follow on the radio

indicators.note: words broadcast on the radio are heard, not seen, so the clue wants a word that sounds alike

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them closely

explanation.surface: A tale heard over the airwaves that the listener is meant to keep up with.
explanation.definitionFit: A tale is a narrative, whether true or invented, just as a story is.

clue.text: Mother going inside to sell axe

indicators.note: the mother word is put inside the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
to hawk goods is to sell them in the street
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A mother heads indoors to sell off an axe.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomahawk is a light Native American hatchet.

clue.text: Delicate material covering top of nuclear weapon

parts.note: lace is a fine openwork fabric

parts.note: only its first letter is used

clue.text: Probe fashionable expedition

parts.note: in means in fashion

explanation.surface: Investigating a trendy journey of exploration.

clue.text: Nerd from southern Europe runs away

parts.note: Greek means coming from Greece
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

clue.text: Plant covering bottom of flower on a swamp

in a down clue the bottom of a word is its last letter

parts.note: only its last letter is used
taken as written

clue.text: Wet weather beginning to move on shortly

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: only its opening letter is used
taken as written

clue.text: One scavenging some filthy enamel

clue.text: Pick out road material to acquire

parts.note: tar is used in surfacing roads

explanation.definitionFit: To target someone is to single them out as the object of attention or attack.

clue.text: Good job it's thoroughly cooked

second meaning: describing meat cooked all the way through

explanation.walkthrough: Praise for a cook whose steak has been left on the heat long enough.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a congratulation and the term for meat with no pink left.

clue.text: Reconstruct Iceland's worst fortress

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped
taken as written

parts.note: a maze is a labyrinth
taken as written

clue.text: Alpine dancing from a mountainous country

parts.note: taken as written, its letters rearranged

clue.text: Collect a male donkey

parts.note: taken as written
an ass is a donkey

clue.text: Island with a fee

parts.note: taken as written
a toll is a charge for using a road or bridge

explanation.surface: An island where visitors must pay a charge.

clue.text: Lass arranged a dance

parts.note: taken as written, its letters rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: the spirit loses a piece, which is removed

parts.note: a genie is a spirit of Arabian folklore

explanation.surface: A genie gives up a share of what it was bequeathed.
